Subject: Post-discovery: 30-min preview — two preferred slots + flexible option

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — really appreciated the clarity on your evaluation goals and latency/cost constraints for the recommendations engine. Quick recap from our side:

- Primary use case: real-time reranking of recommendation candidates in the product feed (95th pctl latency target ~120ms).
- Data footprint: short context windows (~128 tokens), payloads include user metadata (no PII expected).
- Success for the pilot: proof of concept with 50k daily requests and profile showing cost/latency tradeoffs.

Next step: a short 30-minute product preview where we’ll walk through the runtime, bottleneck tradeoffs (batching vs latency), and an ops checklist for Dedicated/Private options. Can you pick between the two preferred slots below, or suggest a quick alternative? Time zone: PT.

Option A: Tue 2026-09-14 10:00–10:30 PT
Option B: Wed 2026-09-15 14:00–14:30 PT
If neither works, we can also do a flexible band Thu 2026-09-16 09:00–12:00 PT (30-minute carve-out).

Please include the folks who will attend from your side — ideal attendees: the engineering lead and the person who owns the recommendation pipeline.

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf (one-page product summary) and a short 30-min agenda draft.

Ben (cc’d) will be the ops/livetime contact on our side and can handle calendar invites / tech attendee coordination.

Next steps we’ll take after you confirm a slot:
- Send calendar invite + meeting notes doc
- Prep a 10-minute tailored walkthrough based on any sample latency numbers you share

Appreciate it — looking forward to locking something in.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
